title: Evidence type fabric.http.observation/v1 (spec 053 §3.2, §5.4; spec 056 M2)
description: The one item of an http.nonmodel record: which allowlist rule matched, the scheme and port, the redirect hop, how complete each body is, and the dialect parser selected. Metadata only: method, status and host travel as telemetry keys (N43); target, path, query and bodies travel as network.* content bodies (N44), never here; raw headers are never recorded. Closed: no other property, no free text. Spec 056 M2 emits dialect none only; jsonrpc2 and qdrant_rest_v1 stay with spec 053 WP4-05.

rule_index.description: META: the index of the matching host rule in the install-time allowlist.

redirect_index.description: META (N44): the hop of a redirect chain; 0 for the first request. httpx follows redirects through the transport, so each hop is its own attempt.

redirect_of.description: ID: the previous hop's attempt uid (uuid4).

request_body.description: META (N44): how complete the recorded request body is.

response_body.description: META (N44): how complete the recorded response body is; early_close is partial, never EOF.

dialect.description: META: the offline parser the reader selects for the stored bytes (N26, N28).

error_class.description: LABEL: the raised exception class's __qualname__, never its message.
